title: Emoji Stories: What Happened?
description: Each line of emoji tells a tiny story. Choose the sentence that tells it best, then retell it in your own words.

thumbnail.alt: A comic strip made of emoji in three panels

options.text: It started to rain, so she opened her umbrella and felt happy.
It was sunny, so she went to the beach.
She lost her umbrella in the rain.
She was sad because it rained.
His alarm rang, but he overslept, ran to the bus stop and missed the bus.
He woke up early and walked to school.
He took a nap on the bus.
He was late because the bus broke down.

questions.explanation: To oversleep = to sleep longer than you planned.

options.text: They had a birthday party for Grandma.
Grandma baked a cake for a wedding.
They bought presents for a baby.
Grandma went to a concert.

questions.explanation: Cake, presents and a party for an older woman: Grandma's birthday.

options.text: The dog buried a bone in a hole.
The dog fell into a hole.
The dog ate a big dinner.
The dog found a lost toy.

questions.explanation: To bury something = to put it in the ground.

options.text: She got a sad message on her phone and started to cry.
She broke her phone and bought a new one.
She called her friend to say happy birthday.
She laughed at a funny video.

questions.explanation: A broken heart on a phone usually means bad news.

options.text: At the store, his card didn't work and he felt embarrassed.
He bought a new credit card online.
He forgot his shopping list.
The store was closed.

questions.explanation: Embarrassed = you feel uncomfortable or a little ashamed because of something that happened in front of other people.

options.text: Something caught fire in the kitchen and the firefighters came.
They cooked breakfast at the fire station.
The chef won a cooking contest.
They had a barbecue in the backyard.

questions.explanation: To catch fire = to start burning.

options.text: Her suitcase got lost after the flight.
She packed her suitcase for a trip.
She missed her flight.
She bought a new suitcase at the airport.

questions.explanation: The question mark tells us something is missing.
